integrationStatus: Art review and baked atlases only; gameplay charge events are not wired yet.
registration: Five copies of the source actor with authored position, phase and reaction-delay tracks.

animations.label: Idle
animations.description: Five mounted spearmen hold the standard two-back, three-front ranks.

animations.label: Movement
animations.description: Five approved horse walk cycles with independent phase offsets.

animations.label: Spear thrust
animations.description: Held spear thrusts from standard ranks, with a restrained front-to-back stagger.

animations.label: Get hit
animations.description: Light mounted hit reactions through all five riders and horses.

animations.label: Get charged
animations.description: The front three horses brace and stumble first, then the back two; all riders stay mounted and recover.

animations.label: Charge in
animations.description: Rear riders gallop forward through open lanes into the inner wedge. Front flanks arc outward and become the trailing pair; the center rider leads.

animations.label: Maintain charge
animations.description: Five horses repeat the approved gallop in a fixed V-shaped wedge until charge attack or exit is requested.

animations.label: Charge thrust
animations.description: Forward spear thrust from the tip, then the inner pair, then the trailing pair. All five retain their spears and recover in the wedge.

animations.label: Transition out
animations.description: The trailing pair advances back into the front flanks while the inner pair returns to the rear rank. Slow to the approved walk and settle into the exact starting formation.

animations.label: Death
animations.description: Front three fall first, then the rear pair. Three horses and riders fall together; two riders are thrown free as their horses fall separately. All five horses and five riders remain down.

chargeSequence.reviewTravelNote: Forward travel is an inspection reference only. It scrolls the review ground; it is never baked as squad movement or applied to gameplay.

gameplayContract.note: Presentation contract only. Existing gameplay owns world movement, charge contact, attack authorization and damage. These tracks only compose local sprite poses.
